biography.plain_text: Roberto Tomasini Grinover is an Italian competitive sailor who won the Melges 32 European championship in 2014. His racing achievements brought him Giornale della Vela's Sailor of the Year award the following year. Competing with tactician Vasco Vascotto, he also won the Barcolana, the annual mass-start sailing race held off Trieste.

long_biography.plain_text:
Roberto Tomasini Grinover learned to race at Monfalcone's Oscar Cosulich sailing club, sailing dinghies and competing alongside Mauro Pelaschier. The Star class later taught him to combine crew coordination with detailed equipment adjustment. He chose the Melges 32 because its owner-driver rules allowed an amateur helmsman to compete with a professional crew, while demanding more organised teamwork.

For his subsequent Mini Maxi campaign, he recruited experienced team manager Federico Michetti and established a base in Palma de Mallorca. Between events, the team worked through modifications intended to improve speed and performance. He particularly valued short-course racing, where close manoeuvres and decisions made within seconds could determine the result.
